autonomous_processes: None affecting task state or outcome; canonical state changes only through pointer handlers or reset/submit actions. CSS transitions and collision shake are presentation effects.
grouped_control_modes: D_parcel_drag: all direct-canvas active-parcel drags in the required projection(s)

clause_i.reason: An observation-free policy using only prior actions and task times cannot choose correct screen coordinates across seeds because the generator randomizes view mirror, scale, and origin. The current screenshot reveals those projection differences.

clause_ii.reason: A single screenshot is sufficient: it visibly shows the active parcel, marked frame, giant bay, and projection geometry needed to select the drag. No recent temporal sequence is needed.

clause_iii.reason: There is no autonomous task-state evolution while the agent supplies no action. Parcel position, scale, portal availability, and delivery availability remain unchanged during waiting, so no useful action becomes unavailable or less effective within any Delta. State changes occur only from pointer events.

source_evidence.claim: D1 starts at human scale and requires only the human-to-giant portal and human/giant views.
Full interaction is direct dragging; observation_window_ms is 0 and frames_per_observation is 1.
View matrices, origins, and mirror are randomized across seeds, creating visually different static projection geometries.
D1 removes gates, sets the parcel to human scale, and limits required portals/views.
Initial parcel/scale state is initialized and remains fixed until interaction.
Canonical parcel movement and portal transitions are driven by pointer drag start/move/end handlers.
Reset and submit are explicit controls; no autonomous task update loop is present.
The grader initializes parcel state and then processes a finite submitted event transcript.
Outcome-affecting state changes are replayed from explicit drag and parking events.
The solver completes D1 through direct drags and explicit submission, with no waiting or temporal observation.
